item.title: [Indiv VIA] Acid Camp 2026 Recruitment
item.description: 🌟 One weekend. A lifetime of impact. 🌟 Spend two days building friendships, creating memories, and supporting persons with intellectual disabilities at ACID 2026: One MINDS MYG, All Stars! Organised by MINDS MYG, this 2D1N residential camp aims to promote inclusion, independence, and meaningful interactions between volunteers and persons with intellectual disabilities. 📅 20–21 June 2026 📍 Sarimbun Scout Camp ✨ Volunteer Roles Available 👥 Group Leaders Guide and engage groups of 10-15 PWIDs ( alongside MINDS MYG volunteers), ensuring smooth programme flow and participant safety Build rapport and camaraderie among participants through enthusiastic interaction and teamwork 🎯 Station Masters / Ushers Assist the organising committee in executing camp activities and managing logistics for game stations to ensure smooth event operations Engage and support PWIDs throughout activities by providing clear guidance and fostering a fun, inclusive, and encouraging environment 🤝 Befrienders Accompany and support 2–3 PWIDs throughout the camp, ensuring their safety and well-being during all activities. Engage PWIDs through personalised interaction and guidance to create a more enjoyable and inclusive camp experience. 📸 Photographers Take photographs during the Dry Run and actual event to support the Publicity Team’s coverage of camp activities Document key moments and activities throughout the camp using personal camera equipment. 💡 Through this experience, you will: Develop leadership and communication skills Build empathy and adaptability Attain VIA hours and receive a participation letter 🔗 Registration: https://forms.gle/rbwyswu37SFuNMD26?utm_source=chatgpt.com Training and briefing will be provided before the event. Further details can be found in the registration form. Registration closes once volunteer slots are filled. More information about this project can be found in the infographic below! ⬇️ [IMPORTANT] Do note the changes to key dates: Dry Run: 14 June (Sunday) Exposure Week: 6/7/13 June Whether you're looking to serve, learn, or make meaningful connections, ACID 2026 offers an opportunity to do all three. ⭐

item.title: [VIA] Recruitment for Volunteers (Project Noeul)
item.description: HEY HWA CHONG!!! ☀️🌞 We are Project Noeul, a group of students working with Ren Ci Community Hospital to spread love and joy to the elderly! We will be holding a total of 12 befriending sessions this year with 3 sessions happening in June. We are looking for around 10 volunteers each session. Through simple conversations and activities with the elderly, volunteers will have the opportunity to brighten their day and form genuine connections with them. Volunteers will have to fill up a consent form and more details will be sent out via WhatsApp. Please note that only Hwa Chong Institution students can sign up. As the elderly participants for all sessions per month will be the same, you are strongly encouraged to sign up for all the sessions held in the same month to form stronger and more meaningful bonds with them! We look forward to seeing you! Volunteers should be enthusiastic, caring and have the willing heart to serve! No prior experience will be needed — briefing and guidance will be provided before sessions. Some fun activities include karaoke, polaroid taking, watercolour painting, gardening and so much more! VIA hours 🕰️: 2.5h per session Date & Time (June Sessions) Session 1: 8 June 2026, 2 - 4.30pm Session 2: 10 June 2026, 9 - 11.30am Session 3: 25 June 2026, 9 - 11.30am Venue: Ren Ci @ Ang Mo Kio (Nursing Home) 10 Ang Mo Kio Ave 8, Singapore 567727 Extra information to note: Mask-wearing is required for all volunteers during the session Dress code: Half uniform/School-based T-shirt and long pants, covered shoes (NO slippers, singlets or shorts) Join us if you are interested in serving the wider community and making a tangible impact and feel free to invite your friends to sign up together! (Limited slots available on a first come first serve basis) Signup form: https://forms.gle/DLGE3K57pCB6VS7y7 (latest by 6 June 2359!) Follow our Instagram @project.noeul for more! Thank you and we look forward to serving the elderly with YOU!
